sources.heading: Sources and honesty
sources.sub: Every fact in this game comes from a public source. Here's how to check it.
sources.realBody: Photos, the Moon and Mars maps, dates, distances, mission facts, and hardware status are taken from NASA, JPL, and USGS.
sources.simplifiedBody: Echo and Archive Control are fictional. Most 3D spacecraft are NASA's own published models; Ranger, Surveyor, the laser mirror, the Lunar Rover, and Sojourner are hand-built approximations. Landing, driving, orbit, and battery simulations use real physics ideas with shortened distances and times. Landing-site puzzles and soil charts are illustrations, not data.
sources.date: Facts were checked in November 2026. Missions change, so visit NASA for the latest.
sources.flipbookNotice: The storybook uses the GUL Labs flipbook React binding and its MPL-licensed core. License text and package attribution:

seismic.graph: Four seismic traces move left through fixed red markers A and B.
seismic.title: Seismic Catch
seismic.instructions: Press Capture when all four signals oscillate across the entire window between A and B. Flat sections do not count. Press Space to capture.
seismic.hit: Capture successful: all four channels filled the window.
seismic.miss: Not yet: at least one channel had a flat section in the window.
